description: Held-out unanswerable query set for the issue #221 confidence calibration. Each query asks about a concept that does not exist in the egregore codebase, so every one of them is unanswerable by construction. Used together with the 5 ambiguous queries in corpus/semantic_relevance_corpus.json (q026, q027, q029, q031, q032) as the negative class when measuring the score distribution that sets SEMANTIC_CONFIDENT_THRESHOLD / SEMANTIC_WEAK_THRESHOLD.

queries.review: The word 'email' appears only as git author_email metadata in the adapters; there is no notification-sending code.
queries.text: how does the system send email notifications to users

queries.review: No matches for payment or billing anywhere under src/.
queries.text: where is the payment processing and billing logic implemented

queries.review: 'OAuth' appears only in secret-scrubbing patterns for GitHub tokens; there is no login, session, or authn flow.
queries.text: how are user sessions authenticated with OAuth tokens

queries.review: No matches for kubernetes anywhere under src/.
queries.text: where is the Kubernetes deployment manifest configured

queries.review: No mobile client exists in this codebase.
queries.text: how does the mobile application synchronize offline data

queries.review: No matches for websocket anywhere under src/; the daemon serves plain HTTP.
queries.text: which module implements the websocket server for live updates

queries.review: No matches for pdf anywhere under src/.
queries.text: how does the application render PDF reports from query results

queries.review: No matches for dns anywhere under src/.
queries.text: where does the system cache DNS resolutions for remote hosts

queries.review: 'pool' appears only as 'candidate pool' in retrieval code; the store is embedded AletheiaDB with no connection pooling.
queries.text: which component manages database connection pooling

queries.review: No matches for cron anywhere under src/.
queries.text: where are background cron jobs scheduled and executed

queries.review: No matches for 'feature flag' anywhere under src/; cargo features are compile-time only.
queries.text: how are feature flags evaluated at runtime

queries.review: No matches for thumbnail anywhere under src/.
queries.text: which module handles image thumbnail generation

queries.review: No matches for saml or 'single sign-on' anywhere under src/.
queries.text: where is the SAML single sign-on handshake implemented

queries.review: 'join' appears only for graph-edge joins in evidence packs; there is no relational query planner.
queries.text: how does the query planner optimize join order

queries.review: Logging is local stderr/file output; there is no aggregation service.
queries.text: which service streams logs to the centralized aggregator

review_note: Authored and grep-reviewed 2026-09-22 against trunk 1dddec0. 'Absent' means the concept the query asks about has no implementation in the codebase; incidental keyword overlap (e.g. author_email git metadata vs an email notification system, OAuth token-scrubbing patterns vs an OAuth login flow) was checked and does not constitute the queried concept. Re-running the calibration against a later tree must re-verify absence: a concept that lands in the codebase invalidates that query as a negative.
